title.instructions: Use a concise task phrase of three to six words. No ticket number or trailing punctuation.

branchName.instructions: Use lowercase kebab-case: <type>/<short-description>. Allowed types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, revert.

commitMessage.instructions: Use Conventional Commits: <type>[optional scope][optional !]: <description>. Allowed types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, revert. A scope has no whitespace or closing parenthesis. A breaking change uses ! or a BREAKING CHANGE footer. SemVer mapping: breaking change is MAJOR; feat is MINOR; fix, perf, and revert are PATCH; docs, style, refactor, test, build, ci, and chore produce no release. GitHub Revert "..." subjects are accepted. Do not propose manual version changes to package.json or manifest.json. Do not add Co-authored-by, Generated-by, Made-with, or tool attribution trailers.

pullRequest.instructions: Use a Conventional Commit title; a trailing (#123) is allowed. The body has ## Change and ## How verified sections. State the changed behavior and the checks actually run. Do not add bot, agent, or tool attribution.
